name: Destructeur 2
description: Architecte de guerre martienne concevant les stratégies de siège planétaire et les protocoles d'annexion.

loadout.armor_outfit: Sleek interlocking carmine red plate armor with integrated dark grey ballistic underlayers, angular shoulder pauldrons, an integral helmet featuring an opaque visor and a thin horizontal red slit, and an asymmetrical half-cape with sharply angular edges made of the same carmine red material.
loadout.arsenal: Electromagnetic railgun with a hexagonal barrel, a thermal sword with a glowing red, heat‑hazed blade, and a wrist‑mounted holographic tactical projector capable of displaying planetary siege schematics.

attitude.behavior: Standing in a resolute, forward‑leaning stance, one hand gripping the railgun, the other extended toward a hovering, full‑color holographic map of a besieged planet, surrounded by floating tactical data overlays.
attitude.emotion: Cold, calculating intensity, a relentless Martian zealotry emanating from the thin red visor slit, exuding an aura of unbreakable authority.

palette_names.name: Carmine Red
palette_names.role: Primary dominant surface color (60% of image)

palette_names.name: Neon Red Glow
palette_names.role: Energy accents – visor slit, plasma vents, railgun muzzle flash (10% of image)

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim lighting with a harsh red‑tinted key light, subtle blue‑gray fill to enhance shadows, and localized glow from neon red sources.

camera.angle: Low angle, slight Dutch tilt to emphasize dominance and aggression

scenography.setting: A fortified Martian command platform overlooking a devastated planetary siege, with jagged basalt cliffs and the distant silhouette of an orbital bombardment.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Red‑orange dust clouds, glowing plasma exhaust trails, flickering holographic battle plans, occasional sparks from railgun discharge, thin wisps of heat haze around the thermal sword blade.
